features.title: FastAPI/React skeleton with health check workflow
acceptance: Backend FastAPI app starts and responds to /healthz
Frontend Vite+React+TS app builds and serves
Docker compose brings up both services
Backend tests pass (pytest)
Frontend typecheck and tests pass (vitest)

features.title: iOS device detection and connection workflow
acceptance: API lists connected iOS devices via usbmuxd
Frontend shows device list with status
User can select device for deployment

features.title: SwiftPM build orchestration workflow
acceptance: API accepts SwiftPM project path and build configuration
Backend executes swift build for iOS target
Frontend shows build progress and logs
Build artifacts accessible for deployment

features.title: App installation and launch workflow
acceptance: API installs .app bundle to selected device
Frontend triggers install and shows progress
App launches on device with debug logging

features.title: OIDC authentication with Keycloak
acceptance: Backend validates Keycloak tokens
Frontend PKCE login flow works
Protected endpoints require authentication
Roles: viewer, operator, admin

features.title: LLM advisory for build failures
acceptance: Opt-in LLM analysis of build errors
Supports OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama
Advisory responses labeled and grounded in logs
